note: Demo images and what the shipped app (app/model/labels.json) should answer. Lab crops: written by `model/demo_samples.py --data DIR`. Field photos: `python3 model/demo_samples.py --field` downloads the CC BY-NC ones into model/demo_samples/field/ (gitignored, not redistributed) and checks the committed CC BY one; sha256 and size are checked after download. Answers are checked in the real app logic (Chromium, app/infer.js) by `node model/check_demo_samples.mjs` -> reports/model_demo_samples_check.json.
